excerpt.zh:
[from.System.GetName]内的公转周期展现出了引人注目的规律。每颗环绕恒星的行星都以两倍其相邻行星的周期公转着，精确到千分之一秒。

这种怪异的精确比值值得调查。
excerpt.en:
Orbital durations in the [from.System.GetName] system exhibit a remarkable pattern. Each planet orbits the star in exactly double the time of its neighbor, accurate to over a thousandth of a second.

This anomalously perfect ratio warrants investigation.

Orbital durations in the [from.System.GetName] system exhibit a remarkable pattern. Each planet orbits the star in exactly double the time of its neighbor, accurate to over a thousandth of a second.

This anomalously perfect ratio warrants investigation.

texts.zh:
[from.System.GetName]是我们目前为止所遇见的解释轨道共振的最佳案例。

每一颗行星在和邻居到达最近点时都相当于一个周期性引力源，产生了弹弓效应和动量互锁。这种相互作用的不同寻常的稳定性产生了这种高度规律的轨道。

该恒星系为研究行星引力对途径物体运动的加速提供了极好的机会，并可能应用于舰船机动。
texts.en:
[from.System.GetName] exhibits the most perfect example of orbital resonance we have ever encountered.

Each planet exerts a periodic gravitational force on its neighbor when they are at their nearest points, creating a catapult effect and mutually dependent momentum. The unusual stability of these interactions results in highly coordinated orbits.

The system offers an excellent opportunity to study the way planetary gravity accelerates the motion of passing objects, with possible applications to ship maneuvering.

texts.zh: 研究[from.GetName]精准的轨道共振效应将会提升我们对舰船机动中行星引力弹弓效应的理解。
texts.en: Studying the perfect orbital resonance effect on [from.GetName] will improve our understanding of planetary slingshot maneuvers on ships.

texts.zh:
在研究了[from.From.System.GetName]恒星系内独特的轨道共振效应之后，我们对规划舰船最佳飞行路线的方法有了巨大的进展。

这些新的模型可以极其充分地在舰船用光速加减速阶段利用行星引力。
texts.en:
After studying the unique orbital resonance effect in the [from.From.System.GetName] system, we have greatly improved our methods for plotting optimal ship flight paths.

These new models will allow us to take greater advantage of planetary gravity in achieving ship acceleration and deceleration at sublight speeds.
